segments.text: Still confused about what to do after 12th or during graduation? Subscribe full disclosure and I'll be sharing three international certifications that can help you earn in lack. First, ACCA.
It's a UK- based global accounting qualification recognized in 180 plus countries. You can start after 10th and it usually takes 1.5 to 3 years to
complete. Working potential in companies like KPMG, EY, PWC with salaries going up to 12 LPA. Second, USCMA. It focuses
on management, accounting and business strategy. You can start after 12th and it can be completed in 6 to9 months.
Professionals work in companies like Amazon, Infosys and Whipro with salaries up to 9 lak rupees perom. Third, US CPA.
It is one of the highest accounting qualifications in the US recognized globally. It requires graduation. CPAs work in companies like Deote, Morgan
Stanley and Accenture with salaries up to 15 LPA. Want to pursue these courses but don't know how to start? That's where India's leading institute Zel
